name: JAX/Tunix
purpose: Tunix addresses the fragmentation in LLM post-training by providing a comprehensive toolkit for alignment, fine-tuning, RLHF, and distillation. It aims to provide efficient and scalable support for state-of-the-art training performance on TPUs, enabling researchers and practitioners to align models at scale.
coreComponents: Trainers for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), Reinforcement Learning (RL), and Knowledge Distillation
keyCapabilities: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with full-weight and parameter-efficient methods (LoRA, QLoRA)
Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms including PPO, GRPO, and GSPO-token
Preference Tuning with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
Knowledge Distillation strategies (logit-based, attention transfer, feature pooling)
Optimized for TPU performance and scalable multi-host distributed training
integrations: JAX-based modeling frameworks like Flax NNX
High-performance inference engines like vLLM and SGLang-JAX for rollout
MaxText framework for high-performance kernels and model execution
qwix library for parameter-efficient tuning (LoRA, QLoRA)
Pathways for seamless multi-host distributed training
useCases: Aligning pre-trained LLMs into production-ready systems
Research and engineering for post-training LLMs and knowledge distillation
Large-scale fine-tuning and RL experiments on TPUs or multi-GPU clusters
Training LLMs to play games for reasoning benchmarks and agentic AI
Data-centric learning and iterative data analysis for LLM improvement
